facts.fact: Guineenews reports that ANDE is developing a public key infrastructure (PKI) to secure electronic signatures, and that nine draft texts on the state's electronic signature were under review on 21 October 2026.

GIN.note: Sovereignty is mentioned only in general terms; no data policy, hosting or contract terms stated.

facts.fact: A government representative said article 1003 of the Civil Code gives strict equivalence between handwritten and electronic signature, per Guineenews.
Guineenews reports an implementing decree fixing the modalities of electronic signature under article 1003 of the Civil Code was adopted on 19 August 2026.

GIN.note: E-services are mentioned only as progress by ANDE, with no service, count or portal named.
